city.panel.help.boosters_body: Match 4: Line Bolt. L or T match: Surtr Bomb (3x3). Match 5: Bifrost Shard. Swap Bifrost Shard with a Line Bolt or Bomb to transform every rune of that color into boosters!
city.panel.help.obstacles_body: Ice Plates: match over them (1-2 hits). Fenrir Chains: match the chained rune. Frost Crates: match adjacent or blast with tools. Niflheim Frost spreads if no ice breaks on a turn.
city.panel.help.village_body: Rebuilt structures grant permanent bonuses and periodic tributes on the map. Each building discovers relics for Nine Realms chests. Complete Daily Trials in a row for streak rewards!

tutorial.step0: Jarl Halvar: Welcome to Wyrdstone! Click the Great Hall and press Play Runes to gather your first Timber & Gold.

chapter.great_hall.title: Chapter I - The Hearth Rekindled
chapter.great_hall.line1: Jarl Halvar: The Great Hall stands proud once more! Smoke rises over the fjord, and our banners call scattered clans home.
chapter.great_hall.line2: The Forge, Longship Dock, and Shrine of Odin are now open to rebuild. Grow the settlement to challenge the Mythological Bosses.
chapter.forge.title: Chapter II - Embers of Nidavellir
chapter.forge.line1: Brokk the Smith: The anvil rings! Your runes strike harder now, and runic tools can be forged for the toughest boards.
chapter.forge.line2: Every tier of the Forge permanently boosts your Match-3 score across the entire Saga.
chapter.longship_dock.title: Chapter III - Sails on the Fjord
chapter.longship_dock.line1: Astrid the Navigator: Our drakkars touch the ice-free waters! Extra moves and richer plunder await every voyage.
chapter.longship_dock.line2: Try the Endless Expedition when you feel ready for roguelite waves and divine boons.
chapter.odin_shrine.title: Chapter IV - Gaze of the Allfather
chapter.odin_shrine.line1: Seeress Freydis: Odin's ravens circle the stones. Divine Fury now charges faster and strikes with mythic might.
chapter.odin_shrine.line2: Switch your Patron God right inside the building inspector before each battle to counter any board.
chapter.meadery.title: Chapter V - Horns of Valhalla
chapter.meadery.line1: Innkeeper Bjorn: Golden honey-mead flows again! Your Endurance cap rises and recovers faster between expeditions.
chapter.meadery.line2: Keep a horn ready in the top bar whenever you want to push one more Raid or Mastery board.
chapter.watchtower.title: Chapter VI - Heimdall's Vigil
chapter.watchtower.line1: Jarl Halvar: From the Watchtower beacon we see across the Nine Realms! Starting boosters now bless your toughest fights.
chapter.watchtower.line2: The fjord is reborn. Claim Legendary Mastery and bring down Fenrir, Jormungandr, Surtr, and Hel!
city.panel.settings.title: Settings & Accessibility
city.panel.help.controls_body: Click/Drag or Arrows+Enter to swap. Space: Divine Fury. 1-6: Active Tools. H: Hint. Backspace: Free Undo. M: Mute. Escape: Pause/Cancel.
city.panel.help.fog_curse_body: Fog conceals runes until revealed by an adjacent match or tool. Cursed runes count down each turn and freeze neighbors at 0.
match3.valhalla.skip_hint: Click or press Space to skip
save.notice.recovered_from_backup: Progress restored from the backup copy.
save.warning.newer_version: This save was made by a newer version of Wyrdstone. Update the game to continue it; progress made now will not be saved.
save.warning.read_only: The save file could not be read. Progress will not be saved until the problem is fixed. The original file was kept. Restart the game to load your progress.
save.notice.unreadable_backed_up: The save could not be read. A copy of it was kept next to it. A new saga was started.
